description: Implementation of the NtlmBufferWriter class for handling NTLM buffer writing operations, including methods for writing integers, strings, security buffers, and target info pairs.

classes.name: NtlmBufferWriter
classes.description: A class for writing data into an NTLM buffer, supporting various data types and structures.

methods.name: CanWrite
methods.description: Checks if a specified number of bytes can be written to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteFlags
methods.description: Writes negotiate flags as a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes a span of bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteZeros
methods.description: Writes zeros to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteSecurityBuffer
methods.description: Writes a security buffer structure to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteAvPairHeader
methods.description: Writes an AV pair header with an ID and length.

methods.name: WriteAvPairTerminator
methods.description: Writes an AV pair terminator.

methods.name: WriteAvPair
methods.description: Writes an AV pair structure.

methods.name: WriteUtf8String
methods.description: Writes a UTF-8 string to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUtf16AsUtf8String
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 string to UTF-8 and writes it.

methods.name: WriteUtf8AsUtf16String
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to UTF-16 and writes it.

methods.name: WriteUtf16String
methods.description: Writes a UTF-16 string to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteSignature
methods.description: Writes the NTLM signature to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteMessageType
methods.description: Writes a message type to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteMessageHeader
methods.description: Writes a message header with signature and type.

methods.name: WriteUInt
methods.description: Template method for writing an unsigned integer of any size.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets the current cursor position in the buffer.
